preRegistered.note: hypotheses H1-H3 and the arm/eqcode mapping were written into tools/jshis-decompose.js BEFORE the first measured run; verdicts are computed mechanically from the measurement. This report is a frozen MEASUREMENT, not a calibration input (data-honesty rule).

hypotheses.H1: the TTL tail overprediction at the Nankai-adjacent sites (kochi, osaka) is PPE-carried — ppeEquiv RP475 ratio >= TTL ratio at both sites
hypotheses.H2: sendai's TTL ratio masks a PPE deficit — our PPE-arm RP475 at sendai under-predicts J-SHIS PPE (ratio < 1): the registered Japan-Trench M9 coverage gap lives in the subduction component
hypotheses.H3: the Vs30-basis confound is bounded — our TTL RP475 over the Vs30 ladder {400,500,600,700,800} moves by <30% vs the 600 baseline at every site

armMapping.ppeEquiv: interplate+intraslab grid + nankaiFullM89/nankaiEastM82/nankaiWestM83 vs PPE_MTTL (海溝型)
armMapping.ppeEquivNoSlab: interplate grid + Nankai scenarios vs PPE_MTTL (intraslab-mapping sensitivity)
armMapping.ppeEquivTd: hazardCurveTimeDependent(horizon 30y) on ppeEquiv vs PPE_MTTL (J-SHIS carries renewal-conditional characteristic rates)
armMapping.lndEquiv: crustal grid + tokyoInland vs LND_MTTL (活断層などの浅い地震)

eqcodeMeaning.LND_MTTL: 活断層などの浅い地震 (2020版〜)

provenance.license: NIED J-SHIS (防災科研 地震ハザードステーション) — government open data
provenance.note: raw 30-yr probabilities embedded per site per eqcode; annual rate = -ln(1-p)/30 (Poisson window conversion, same convention as the v2 total-curve report)

basis.jshis: Y2024 NIED national model, average case, per-eqcode component curves, engineering bedrock
basis.ours: quake-sim-psha-source-v2 class-filtered submodels, 3-family GMPE logic tree (LLH weights), PGV at Vs30=600 reference, modelBias deliberately not applied
basis.confound: Vs30=600 reference vs engineering-bedrock basis — quantified by the Vs30 ladder arm in this report (H3)

H1.registered: the TTL tail overprediction at the Nankai-adjacent sites (kochi, osaka) is PPE-carried — ppeEquiv RP475 ratio >= TTL ratio at both sites

H2.registered: sendai's TTL ratio masks a PPE deficit — our PPE-arm RP475 at sendai under-predicts J-SHIS PPE (ratio < 1): the registered Japan-Trench M9 coverage gap lives in the subduction component

H3.registered: the Vs30-basis confound is bounded — our TTL RP475 over the Vs30 ladder {400,500,600,700,800} moves by <30% vs the 600 baseline at every site

findings.headline: eqcode-decomposed gate (Y2024): TTL RP475 ratio median x1.827 splits into PPE (subduction + Nankai scenarios) x1.827 and LND (crustal + capital scenario) x0.852 — the 1.83x residual is NOT uniformly distributed across tectonic classes
findings.mappingSensitivity: intraslab assignment: ppeEquiv x1.827 vs ppeEquivNoSlab x1.825 (J-SHIS does not publish whether PPE_MTTL carries intraslab events; both mappings reported)
findings.timeDependent: ppeEquivTd RP475 ratio median x4.538 vs stationary ppeEquiv x1.827; mid-band log10 rate ratio medians: ppeEquiv 0.293 -> ppeEquivTd 0.671 (J-SHIS PPE carries renewal-conditional characteristic rates; v2 TD arm context applies)
findings.verdicts: H1 SUPPORTED | H2 REFUTED | H3 SUPPORTED
findings.honestyNote: frozen measurement on quake-sim-psha-source-v2 with the official Y2024 component curves fetched live 2026-10-13; no engine/model parameter was tuned from it. The TTL arm reproduces the v2 frozen total-curve RP475 ratios (tokyo x1.585 anchor) — official curves stable across the 2026-09-09..10-13 window.
